propositions: Status mapping is currently hardcoded; forward outbound uses built-in local_to_jira_status map at CREATE/UPDATE with no per-project override capability
Inbound recovery of non-built-in statuses relies on hardcoded rebar-status labels (blocked/cancelled only); a project needing remap or collapse has no echo-safe path
Unmapped local statuses must drift (omit status field, leave Jira unchanged) with deduplicated non-fatal alerts, never coerce to a default nor fail the mutation

Config-driven forward map resolved per-project via S1 MappingLayer (builtin ← default ← projects.<KEY>) must be threaded through outbound CREATE/UPDATE via status_map parameter without reverse-map dependency inbound

Generalized rebar-status:<local> stamping rule must round-trip any config remap or collapse: label iff config target differs from built-in canonical, inbound recovers via derived vocabulary covering all local status values
Fetcher known-set and preflight validation must tolerate config-declared Jira statuses absent from built-in map to prevent spurious warnings on remapped projects
